notes.title: Super Trunko Go game retirement announcement.
notes.content: [p]After much reflection, we've made the decision to retire Super Trunko Go from Steam.[/p][p]The process of removal begins as of this announcement.[/p][p][/p][p]This wasn't a decision we took lightly, as Super Trunko Go has been a meaningful part of our journey at 88 Polygons Ltd. [/p][p]We are grateful to everyone who played and supported the game, and we are proud of what we built.[/p][p][/p][p]After removal, if you already own the game, you will still be able to download and play it as usual from your Steam library.[/p][p]Once again, thank you for being part of this chapter! [/p][p][/p][p]88 Polygons Ltd.[/p]

notes.title: Important Update for Super Trunko Go followers
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
Thank you all for your continued support.


I would like to relay some issues that I have currently been experiencing. 
I have hit quite a number of obstacles with trying to get the controller to connect 
without problems. I have therefore made the difficult decision to release the 
game on Steam for keyboard/ mouse and Steam Deck play only.

I apologise to anyone who was looking forward to a controller experience,
which leads me to remind that we have a publisher working on the console 
versions (Switch, Xbox, Playstation) and are expected to be released later 
in the year.  Stay tuned!
